question: Five colleagues each keep re-uploading the same three reference documents into their own chats, and they want one shared place for that context. What should the team do first?
options: A) Check which plan they are on, since sharing one project with colleagues needs Team or Enterprise.
B) Nominate one person to hold the documents and forward the answers on to the rest of the team each time.
C) Ask Claude to remember the three documents so that everyone's chats can draw on them later.
D) Create a project each and upload the same three documents into every one of those projects.
correct_answers: A) Check which plan they are on, since sharing one project with colleagues needs Team or Enterprise.
explanations: Correct. On personal plans a project is private to its creator, so on Free, Pro or Max each colleague would still end up maintaining a separate copy of the same knowledge.
Incorrect. Routing every question through one colleague creates a bottleneck and does not give anyone else the shared context they need.
Incorrect. Context from one person's conversations does not carry across to colleagues' chats; shared knowledge has to be held somewhere deliberately.
Incorrect. Five parallel copies is the duplication they are trying to remove, and the copies will drift apart as documents are updated.
